{{Top|leg}}
The '''Corellian Quarter''' was an area of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], primarily inhabited by [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] immigrants and people of Corellian heritage. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], residences there were subjected to many raids by [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] forces.
